selection: Select epoch and L1 by validation reconstruction MSE separately for each architecture/K/seed. Freeze every model before development inspection. For competence gate select K by seed-averaged validation predictive R2; report every K, never replace failed candidates.
architecture_reference: Gu, Kelly and Xiu (2021), doi:10.1016/j.jeconom.2020.07.009; architecture-level implementation, not exact reproduction of their sample, tuning or annual refitting
feature_policy: First 92 ranked characteristics from the archived common mother panel; no missing-indicator expansion. Factor encoder uses constant plus 92 ridge characteristic-managed portfolios. Both arms identical.
prediction: Fixed fitted model. At month t use beta(z[t-1]) times expanding mean of strictly earlier factor realizations. Contemporaneous f[t] only for total R2 and realized pricing factors.
primary: Combined74 development HJ-type distance with covariance weight and SDF coefficients fitted to validation; simultaneous paired K differences for CAE across 15 comparisons.
secondary: FF5+momentum reference under identical pricing criterion
bootstrap dimension winner frequencies within fixed geometry
three asset families and five geometry weights, explicitly different objectives
descriptive 1% FF6-distance tolerance sets, no confidence-set claim
stopping_rule: One immutable run; no architecture, seed, K, time period, regularization or threshold expansion after inspection. Report adverse and inconclusive results. A failed competence gate limits representativeness and does not trigger another model search. Technical bugs require append-only failure receipt and separately versioned correction.
limitations: historical data already used in prior research; not fresh confirmation
archived characteristic bridge is not independent point-in-time reconstruction
architecture-level CAE implementation; no claim to exactly reproduce published performance
bootstrap conditional on trained models and validation coefficients; does not repeat training or provide structural K coverage
metric weight changes represent different objectives, not a pure reparameterization
linear loading control is CA0 architecture, not a separately optimized ALS-IPCA estimator
point competence criteria are not proof of statistical noninferiority or universal model adequacy
